The '''Revenant Speeder''' was a type of [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] utilized by the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]]. It was also referred to as the '''Pirate Speeder Bike'''.

==Characteristics==
The Revenant Speeder was a [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] that was propelled by two large engines. A laser cannon turret was mounted on the top near the rear of the craft. It was manned by a gunner who sat in an unenclosed seat.

==History==
Revenant Speeders were used by the Revenants at the [[Battle of Lok (32 BBY)|First Battle of Lok]]; first to escort a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], and later to patrol the area around [[Nym's Base]]. During the battle, [[Jinkins]] was nearly killed in one of these bikes, but was saved by [[Nym/Legends|Nym]] in his [[Havoc (starfighter)|''Havoc'']]. [[22 BBY/Legends|Ten years later]], three of these speeder bikes were used by the pirates at the [[Battle of Lok (22 BBY)|Second Battle of Lok]]. [[Sol Sixxa]] used one to set explosives on a door to Nym's Base, then under control of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]].
